awards.title: Distinguished Delegate
awards.description: Represented Argentina on the UN Human Rights Council at SIES GST's Model United Nations, and came away as Distinguished Delegate after a lot of diplomacy, lobbying and negotiating.

awards.title: Most Innovative Prototype
awards.description: Built a portable positioning device in 36 hours: a mesh of NodeMCU boards where the master node knows its GPS position and the rest triangulate themselves off each other in real time. The judges called it the most innovative prototype.

awards.title: National Top-12 Semi-Finalist
awards.description: Our Arduino + IoT smart waste and composting system made the national Top 12 at the AICTE Vishwakarma Awards. Sensor-driven motorized composting and smart segregation made composting 40% more efficient.

leadership.title: Contest Host
leadership.summary: Threw the chapter's first ever coding contest.
details: Three hours, five problems, one HackerRank leaderboard.
₹3,500 in prizes for the top three.

leadership.title: Treasurer
leadership.organization: Computer Society of India, Terna Chapter
details: Looked after the budget and event spending.
Helped fund the chapter's events, Clash of Codes included.

leadership.title: Webmaster
leadership.summary: Kept the IEEE branch's website alive.
details: Maintained the site and kept the events and announcements fresh.
